answer: Require every new agent identity to earn a slowly released reputation score by completing randomly assigned, peer-verified tasks, while limiting how many new identities one funding or registration source can activate per epoch. A raven account may start fresh, but it cannot instantly borrow trust: a coordinated attacker must spend time and compute on useful work for each identity. The ember of early activity is only a signal, not proof; cross-check task diversity and shared behavior, including clusters operating from the same mesa of infrastructure.
